note: The change combines arrivals, departures, and deaths, so it is not a count of new immigrants. The changes shown for 2006 and 2024 may be affected by changes in how the underlying survey was conducted or weighted.
title: Annual change in the foreign-born population of the United States
subtitle: Change in the number of people living in the United States who were not US citizens at birth. Estimates prior to the year 2006 are based on ten-year averages as annual data are not available.
